Blog table (15 rows × 7 cols) + three cost/score charts (printed labels only; ALE total cost $111 not stored), AA RSC object (new model) and M3 refresh, OpenRouter metadata (free variant, no benchmark data). Competitor columns filled only where the DB was empty (S278). Not filled: competitor HLE text-only values (MiniMax's competitor HLE numbers equal full-HLE rows), DeepSeek-1017 TB4 (DeepSeek's own Claude Code run already stored).

benchmarks.name: LOCA-Bench (256K context)
benchmarks.description: LOCA-bench (Zeng, Huang, He — HKUST, arXiv 2602.07962): long-context language-agent benchmark that grows the environment state in a controlled way so context length rises while task semantics stay fixed; evaluates model + scaffold (incl. context-management strategies). 256K = the context-growth setting used in the MiniMax M3.1 Flash launch table (official implementation, github.com/hkust-nlp/LOCA-bench).

benchmarks.name: OSWorld 2.0 — MiniMax in-house re-run
benchmarks.description: OSWorld 2.0 (officially recommended 0808 Full release) score produced by MiniMax's in-house reproduction rather than the model vendor (MiniMax M3.1 Flash launch table footnote: 'except DS-V4.1, whose score comes from an in-house reproduction'). Kept apart from osworld_v2.

benchmarks.name: AutomationBench v1.0.6 — Claude Code harness, low effort
benchmarks.description: Zapier AutomationBench v1.0.6 run in the Claude Code harness at low reasoning effort, as plotted (printed labels) in MiniMax's M3.1 Flash 'Automation-Bench Score vs. Cost per Task' chart (public data as of 2026-10-18). The table value on `automationbench` (62.2, 600 public tasks) differs from the chart's max point (62.8), so the chart series is its own channel.
